## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 7-juan Yuán imperial agricultural manual, commissioned by Khubilai Khan and prepared by the *Sīnóngsī* (Office of Agricultural Affairs). The work was distributed for use by local officials throughout the empire from *Zhìyuán* 10 (1273) onward; the standard recension dates to *Zhìyuán* 23 (1286). The work synthesises the *Qí mín yào shù* ([KR3d0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3d/KR3d0001)) and Sòng-period agricultural literature with Yuán-period field experience. The frontmatter brackets to 1273–1286.

**Abstract**

The *Nóngsāng jí yào* is the principal Yuán-imperial agricultural manual. The bibliographic record: *Yuán shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Nóngjiā lèi*.
